decisions.decision: Implement a direct conservative precaution and a qualified explanatory Note.
decisions.reason: The independently attested native-word sense of 墓 includes the marker itself. 標/しるし independently has the mark/sign sense, and the displayed counterpart label includes mark. The marker overlap is therefore more specific than a shared burial topic or a compound-only inference. A generic mark is not a grave, and grave is not an unrestricted standalone gloss of 標. The Note must state that distinction rather than teach synonymy.

decisions.decision: Implement a separate direct conservative precaution and a qualified explanatory Note.
decisions.reason: Independent 塔 entries establish its religious tower/stupa sense, while complete 石塔 entries explicitly identify stone towers used as graves as well as grave markers. The independent 仏塔 account confirms particular stone-pagoda forms used as grave markers. This supports a bounded tower-shaped grave/marker overlap, not only a common religious topic. Do not equate every tower, pagoda or ordinary 供養塔 with a grave; do not transfer the wooden-tablet sense of 卒塔婆 to standalone 塔 or turn historical word origins into an unrestricted modern gloss.
